```yaml
name: Publish Remote Config

on:
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  publish:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.12'

      - name: Install uv
        run: |
          curl -LsSf https://astral.sh/uv/install.sh | sh
          echo "$HOME/.cargo/bin" >> $GITHUB_PATH

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: uv sync --frozen

      - name: Lint with Ruff
        run: uvx ruff check --select I .

      - name: Format check with Ruff
        run: uvx ruff format --check .

      - name: Type check with Pyright
        run: uv run pyright .

      - name: Run tests
        run: uv run python -m pytest --benchmark-quiet -q .

      - name: Generate remote config
        run: |
          # The project provides a CLI to export the remote config.
          # Adjust the module path if the CLI is located elsewhere.
          uv run python -m kiln.remote_config.export --output remote_config.json

      - name: Prepare remote config directory
        run: |
          mkdir -p remote-config
          cp remote_config.json remote-config/

      - name: Deploy to GitHub Pages
        uses: peaceiris/actions-gh-pages@v3
        with:
          github_token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          publish_dir: remote-config
          destination_dir: .
          keep_files: true
```
